”当前，各国人工智能治理仍处于快速探索阶段，制度规范、监管路径和技术标准存在差异: "Currently, AI governance in various countries remains in a stage of rapid exploration, with differences in institutional norms, regulatory pathways, and technical standards. 强化创新发展和开放生态，拓展全球人工智能发展机遇: Strengthen innovation and development and foster an open ecosystem to expand global AI development opportunities.

落实四大全球倡议 推进人工智能全球治理（人民要论）: Implement Four Major Global Initiatives to Advance Global AI Governance (People's Forum)
今年7月，习近平主席出席2026世界人工智能大会暨人工智能全球治理高级别会议开幕: In July this year, President Xi Jinping attended the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance and delivered a keynote speech, comprehensively and systematically expounding China's policy stance and principled positions on AI development and governance, pointing out: "All countries should uphold the principle of putting people first and pursuing positive development, make artificial intelligence an important driving force for promoting common prosperity and safeguarding common security, and jointly build a just and rational global AI governance system."
”当前，全球人工智能技术创新正步入密集突破的上升期，各类内生和衍生风险亦随之而来: "Currently, global artificial intelligence technological innovation is entering a period of intensive breakthroughs, and various endogenous and derivative risks are emerging."
习近平主席直面全球人工智能发展与治理的痛点问题，从发展、安全、文明、治理维度提出: President Xi Jinping directly addressed pain points in global AI development and governance, putting forward four suggestions from the dimensions of development, security, civilization, and governance, which are highly consistent with the core essence of the Four Major Global Initiatives, contributing Chinese wisdom and solutions to advancing global AI governance.
人工智能全球治理亟待破局: Global AI governance urgently needs breakthrough.
习近平主席指出：“当前，世界百年变局加速演进，新一轮科技革命和产业变革加速突破，: President Xi Jinping noted: "Currently, the world is experiencing a century of major changes accelerating its evolution, a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation is accelerating its breakthroughs, and global AI technology innovation has entered an unprecedented period of vitality. Intelligent technologies characterized by ubiquitous connectivity, human-machine collaboration, cross-boundary integration, and collaborative sharing are accumulating and releasing enormous energy, presenting both tremendous opportunities and governance challenges."
”人工智能是新一轮科技革命和产业变革的重要驱动力量: "Artificial intelligence is an important driving force in the new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation."
近年来，在算法、数据、算力全链条突破的推动下，人工智能各方面能力快速提升，推动经: In recent years, driven by breakthroughs in the full chain of algorithms, data, and computing power, artificial intelligence capabilities have rapidly improved across all aspects, pushing economic and social development from digitalization and networking toward intelligent transformation at an accelerated pace.
随着人工智能技术发展和应用普及，相关风险愈发突出: As artificial intelligence technology develops and its applications become widespread, related risks are becoming increasingly prominent.
另一方面，人工智能风险具有天然的跨国属性: On the other hand, AI risks have inherent cross-border characteristics.
在一国训练的大模型被另一国用户调用，风险可能随之穿越国界: A large model trained in one country may be called upon by users in another country, and risks may thus cross borders.
此外，不同国家人工智能发展差距持续拉大，还将加剧国际政治经济不平等: Furthermore, the widening AI development gap between different countries will further exacerbate international political and economic inequality.
这就决定了人工智能治理不能局限在单一国家层面，必须在全球层面凝聚治理共识，形成治: This determines that AI governance cannot be confined to a single national level but must reach consensus on governance at the global level and form a joint governance effort.
当前，人工智能全球治理还面临多重挑战，具体体现在以下方面: Currently, global AI governance faces multiple challenges, specifically manifested in the following aspects.
一些国际组织、地区组织将人工智能作为重点议题并形成相关机制，但这些机制的治理主题: Some international and regional organizations have made artificial intelligence a focus issue and formed relevant mechanisms, but these mechanisms differ significantly in governance themes, governance philosophies, institutional arrangements, and policy timelines, and there are no hierarchical relationships or effective coordination among them.
一些关于人工智能全球治理的宣言、倡议等国际文件还停留在原则共识阶段，签署国自行决: Some international documents such as declarations and initiatives on global AI governance remain at the stage of consensus on principles, with signatory countries independently deciding how and to what extent to implement them, while implementation and supervision lack effective institutional safeguards.
人工智能被视为影响国家综合国力的战略性技术: Artificial intelligence is regarded as a strategic technology affecting comprehensive national power.
一些国家出于维护或扩大自身优势的考虑，或拒绝人工智能全球治理，或试图垄断治理规则: Some countries, considering the maintenance or expansion of their own advantages, either refuse to participate in global AI governance or attempt to monopolize the right to set governance rules, eroding the trust foundation of multilateral cooperation and increasing the difficulty of global governance coordination.
这些挑战意味着，推进人工智能全球治理，需要科学清晰的理念引领、稳定有效的制度支撑: These challenges mean that advancing global AI governance requires scientifically clear conceptual guidance, stable and effective institutional support, and substantive and forceful action measures.
四大全球倡议指引人工智能全球治理的正确方向: The Four Major Global Initiatives Point the Correct Direction for Global AI Governance.
当前，国际社会对人工智能的关切涉及技术创新、安全防控、伦理规范、产业发展等诸多领: Currently, international concerns about artificial intelligence span multiple fields including technological innovation, security control, ethical standards, and industrial development, with diverse issues and interlocking challenges. However, fundamentally, these concentrate on four aspects: development, security, civilization, and governance.
习近平主席在这次会议上提出“坚持开放共赢，驱动创新发展”“强化风险意识，确保安全: President Xi Jinping put forward four suggestions at this conference: "Uphold openness and win-win cooperation to drive innovative development," "Strengthen risk awareness to ensure security and controllability," "Encourage inclusive diversity to promote civilizational exchange," and "Advocate harmonious collaboration to improve global governance." These are consistent with the Four Major Global Initiatives and deeply align with the realistic requirements of AI progressing upward and toward good, systematically answering fundamental questions of global AI governance and providing important ideological guidance for breaking through the impasse in global AI governance.
人工智能是一种可以广泛赋能、层层渗透的关键共性技术，如何将其精准嵌入生产生活各环: Artificial intelligence is a key general-purpose technology with broad enabling capacity and pervasive penetration. How to precisely embed it in every link of production and life to become a powerful tool for promoting inclusive development and enhancing people's wellbeing is a test of governance wisdom.
同时，发展中国家在数字基础设施、数据、人才等方面存在短板，人工智能鸿沟加深的风险: Meanwhile, developing countries face shortcomings in digital infrastructure, data, and talent, and the risk of widening AI divides constantly exists.
坚持开放共赢，驱动创新发展，有利于推动人工智能与经济社会发展深度融合，全面赋能农: Upholding openness and win-win cooperation to drive innovative development is conducive to promoting deep integration of artificial intelligence with economic and social development, comprehensively enabling agriculture, manufacturing, urban management, disaster prevention and mitigation, education and healthcare, and other fields, allowing technological progress to quickly translate into tangible improvements in people's lives.
在这一过程中，坚持普惠包容，帮助发展中国家建设人工智能基础设施、培训人工智能人才: In this process, maintaining inclusive and equitable principles, helping developing countries build AI infrastructure and train AI talent, promoting open sharing of AI models, and supporting developing countries in developing localized AI applications will help leverage advanced technology to better harness each country's comparative advantages and help address the problem of unbalanced global development.
当前，人工智能发展带来的安全风险大致包括两类：一是由技术自身导致的内生风险，如算: Currently, security risks arising from AI development are broadly of two types: one is endogenous risks caused by the technology itself, such as algorithmic black boxes, data bias, and transgressing human control boundaries or deviating from human values and instructions.
特别需要指出的是，人工智能被应用于军事领域，将增强态势感知能力、降低打击成本等: It is particularly important to point out that when artificial intelligence is applied in military fields, it will enhance situational awareness capability and lower strike costs.
强化风险意识，确保安全可控，推动各国加强对话协作，就防范底层技术隐患、约束技术恶: Strengthening risk awareness and ensuring safety and controllability, promoting dialogue and cooperation among countries, conducting rule-making consultations and risk prevention partnerships on preventing hidden dangers in underlying technologies and constraining malicious technology abuse, will help establish a solid safety baseline for artificial intelligence.
人工智能对推动人类文明发展进步具有双重作用: Artificial intelligence has a dual role in promoting the development and progress of human civilization.
另一方面，若人工智能大模型训练长期依托少数语言，可能使其他语言和文化在数字空间中: On the other hand, if artificial intelligence large model training relies for a long time on a small number of languages, other languages and cultures may be marginalized in digital space, eroding the diversity of world civilizations.
鼓励包容并蓄，促进文明互鉴，为人工智能发展和治理引入文明视角，用全人类共同价值塑: Encouraging inclusive diversity and promoting mutual learning among civilizations, introducing a civilizational perspective to artificial intelligence development and governance, shaping the values of artificial intelligence with the common values of all humanity, building multilingual and cross-cultural training datasets, allowing different civilizations to be "seen" and "expressed" by algorithms, artificial intelligence can become a bridge for promoting mutual understanding and tolerance among different civilizations.
“倡导和衷共济，完善全球治理”与全球治理倡议一脉相承，为推动加强人工智能全球治理: "Advocating unity in common purpose and improving global governance" is consistent with the Global Development Initiative and establishes guidance for promoting strengthened global governance of artificial intelligence.
当前，人工智能全球治理正处于起步阶段: Currently, global governance of artificial intelligence is in its early stages.
全球治理倡议以奉行主权平等、遵守国际法治、践行多边主义、倡导以人为本、注重行动导: The Global Development Initiative, with its core concepts of respecting sovereign equality, complying with international rule of law, practicing multilateralism, advocating people-centered approaches, and emphasizing action orientation, has established guidance for promoting strengthened global governance of artificial intelligence.
倡导和衷共济，完善全球治理，坚持共商共建共享的全球治理观，切实发挥联合国的重要作: Advocating unity in common purpose and improving global governance, adhering to the concept of global governance based on consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, effectively leveraging the important role of the United Nations, building the rules for global governance of artificial intelligence on the basis of broad international consensus, strengthening coordination and connection of artificial intelligence development strategies, governance rules, and technical standards—this will both facilitate the early formation of a global governance framework with broad consensus, enhance the representation and voice of developing countries in global artificial intelligence governance, and ensure equal rights, equal opportunities, and equal rules for all countries in global artificial intelligence governance, and also facilitate achieving the goal of enhancing people's sense of access, happiness, and security, allowing this cutting-edge technology to better benefit human society and avoid creating new inequalities in the field of artificial intelligence.

随着应用场景日益丰富，中国的人工智能治理也有序展开，为推进人工智能全球治理作出中: As application scenarios become increasingly diverse, China's artificial intelligence governance has proceeded in an orderly manner, making Chinese contributions to advancing global artificial intelligence governance.
中国的人工智能治理实践遵循以人为本、智能向善的价值导向，注重技术进步与社会公平、: China's artificial intelligence governance practice adheres to a value orientation of people-centered development and AI for good, emphasizing coordination between technological progress and social fairness, public order, and comprehensive human development, thereby enhancing overall social welfare.
同时，坚持发展与安全并重，统筹推进技术创新与风险防控，既鼓励人工智能全面赋能经济: At the same time, it insists on equal emphasis on development and security, comprehensively advancing technological innovation and risk prevention and control, both encouraging artificial intelligence to comprehensively enable high-quality economic and social development and attaching importance to establishing a solid safety baseline.
在实践中，中国采取敏捷治理的方式，小步快跑、持续迭代，动态校准治理方案，建立起多: In practice, China adopts an agile governance approach, moving steadily in small steps with rapid iteration, dynamically adjusting governance solutions, establishing a multi-level artificial intelligence legal system, and forming a diversified collaborative governance pattern with government taking the lead, enterprises assuming primary responsibility, and public supervision.
这些实践有力证明，人工智能发展与安全可以统筹兼顾，以人为本、安全可控、公平透明等: These practices powerfully demonstrate that artificial intelligence development and safety can be balanced, principles such as people-centered approaches, safety and controllability, and fairness and transparency can be embedded in the full lifecycle of technology development and application, and agile governance can establish a safety baseline while leaving room for technological innovation.
